description:
MonetizeMore is a leading ad-tech company dedicated to empowering digital publishers to maximize their ad revenue through innovative technology and strategic partnerships. Our cutting-edge platform optimizes ad layouts, leverages header bidding, and integrates advanced analytics to drive superior results for publishers worldwide. Headquartered in Canada with a strong presence in the APAC region, we’re looking for a dynamic Commissioned Sales Representative to join our high-performing team and help publishers thrive in the digital advertising ecosystem.

Job Overview

We are looking for a Media Buyer & Ad Operations Success Manager who excels in both programmatic/media buying and ad tech operations. This role is critical in ensuring the success of our advertising campaigns by optimizing media investments, managing ad tech infrastructure, and driving performance through data-driven strategies.

The ideal candidate has hands-on experience in media buying (paid social, programmatic, search, or video) and a deep understanding of ad serving, tracking, and campaign troubleshooting. You will bridge the gap between media execution and technical ad ops, ensuring seamless campaign delivery and maximizing ROI.

Key Responsibilities

  • Media Buying & Optimization:
    • Plan, execute, and optimize performance-driven media buys across platforms (Meta, Google, DSPs, etc.).
    • Manage budgets, bids, and targeting strategies to maximize campaign performance.
    • Conduct A/B testing, audience segmentation, and funnel optimization.
  • Ad Operations & Technical Management:
    • Oversee ad trafficking, tag implementation (Google Tag Manager, pixels, etc.), and QA.
    • Troubleshoot discrepancies in delivery, tracking, or attribution.
    • Collaborate with internal teams and vendors to resolve technical issues.
  • Performance Analysis & Reporting:
    • Monitor KPIs (CTR, CPA, ROAS) and provide actionable insights.
    • Generate reports and present findings to stakeholders.
    • Ensure alignment between media spend and business objectives.
  • Client & Stakeholder Success:
    • Act as a trusted advisor to internal teams or clients on best practices.
    • Proactively identify opportunities for campaign improvement.

What We're Looking For

  • Analytical Thinking - Ability to interpret data, identify trends, and make data-driven decisions.
  • Technical Proficiency - Familiarity with digital advertising tools and platforms like Google Ad Manager, WordPress, GAM 360, traffic acquisition tools such as Active Campaign and header bidding solutions.
  • Problem-Solving Skills - Resourceful in identifying issues, troubleshooting errors, and finding effective solutions.
  • Attention to Detail - Precision in setting up campaigns, implementing ad tags, or managing publisher configurations to ensure optimal outcomes.
  • Communication Skills - Clarity in conveying technical details, results, and strategies to stakeholders with varying levels of understanding.
  • Client-Centric Mindset - Strong focus on understanding client needs and providing personalized solutions to maximize client satisfaction.
  • Knowledge of Ad Metrics - Understanding of key ad metrics like CPM, CPC, CTR, RPM, and ad yield optimization strategies.
  • Strategic Thinking - Ability to think ahead and align short-term actions with long-term goals, including scaling performance.
  • Sales Acumen - Skills to pitch ad solutions effectively, negotiate deals, and close partnerships with publishers or advertisers.
  • Results-Oriented - Strong drive to achieve and exceed KPIs and revenue targets.
  • Negotiation Skills - Confidence in negotiating with clients, vendors, and partners to secure the best outcomes for the business.
  • Resilience - Ability to handle challenges and setbacks while maintaining motivation and a positive attitude.
  • Data Visualization - Skills to create clear and impactful reports or dashboards to communicate performance and insights effectively.
  • AI Fluency - Understanding and practical application of AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, data enrichment tools, automated workflows) to enhance productivity, decision-making, and campaign performance.

title: SENIOR SOFTWARE ENGINEER NODE
description:
Overview

O Ton é uma empresa do grupo Stone Co., focada em empoderar empreendedores autônomos por meio de soluções financeiras como maquininhas, conta digital, cartão e programa de renda extra. Nosso time é apaixonado por desafios e movido por impacto real na vida dos nossos clientes — sempre com leveza, autonomia e muita colaboração. Aqui, você terá a oportunidade de trabalhar com um time de apaixonados por desafios, sempre preocupado em atender da melhor forma os nossos clientes e buscando as melhores escolhas técnicas para entregar os resultados. E mais importante, tudo isso em um ambiente descontraído com horário flexível e a possibilidade de trabalhar remoto.

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.

The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Nos motivamos a enxergar o impacto do nosso trabalho na vida do cliente, é vendo que melhoramos a vida dele que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.

A equipe do programa Renda Extra | TON está dedicada a transformar vidas por meio de oportunidades únicas de geração de renda. Nosso programa oferece uma maneira inovadora para os nossos parceiros, de obter uma renda adicional ou até mesmo substituir sua fonte de renda principal sem nenhum vínculo empregatício. Nosso objetivo é empoderar as pessoas, proporcionando-lhes os meios para alcançar a estabilidade financeira e crescimento pessoal.

Senior Software Engineer Node

Você terá um papel essencial na evolução do nosso ecossistema, atuando no desenvolvimento de novas funcionalidades, provas de conceito e melhorias contínuas nos nossos microsserviços e aplicações. Esperamos que você contribua ativamente desde a ideação até a entrega, participando de cerimônias, revisando código, mantendo e atualizando a documentação técnica. Fará parte de um time colaborativo, engajado em criar soluções escaláveis e de alto impacto, sempre em alinhamento com os padrões técnicos da companhia. Aqui, valorizamos opiniões, ideias novas e iniciativas — queremos que você protagonize melhorias e ajude a elevar a barra técnica do produto. Também é esperado que você compartilhe conhecimento com o time, lidere refatorações quando necessário, e participe ativamente do refinamento de demandas junto ao time de UX, garantindo entregas com qualidade e foco no cliente.

O que esperamos de você

  • Experiência com NodeJS, TypeScript e Jest
  • Familiaridade com arquitetura moderna: SOLID, Clean Architecture, FaaS, APIs REST/WebSocket
  • Prática com AWS (Lambda, SQS, SNS, API Gateway, S3 etc.) e banco NoSQL (DynamoDB)
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de cache e busca (Redis, OpenSearch/ElasticSearch)
  • Git, CI/CD, documentação técnica e segurança em desenvolvimento

O que aumenta as suas chances

  • Experiência Banco de Dados relacional
  • Experiência com ferramentas de gestão de infraestrutura em código, como Terraform
  • Habilidade de otimização para suporte de alto volume de dados
  • Experiência com ferramentas de observabilidade e monitoramento como DataDog, CloudWatch e Splunk
  • Experiência com automação de Testes e testes de carga (Jest, K6, JMeter)

Benefícios

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico
  • Hospital Digital, da Vitta: com equipe médica 24/7

  • Auxílio Remoto + Setup Inicial (para vagas remotas)

  • Benefício Educação - Plataforma interna com livros, podcasts, treinamentos e videoaulas
  • Auxílio Creche

Etapas do Processo Seletivo

  1. Inscrição: Aqui você começa a sua jornada conosco. Nosso time analisará as informações do seu perfil e entrará em contato em breve.
  2. Entrevistas com o time de People: papo para conhecer nossa cultura, estrutura e o desafio proposto.
  3. Avaliação Técnica: aprofundar hard skills com possibility de dois papos ou um desafio.

  5. Feedback: compartilharemos o feedback independente do resultado.

title: Commissioned Sales Representative - LATAM Region (Remote)
description:
About Monetize More

Monetize More is a leading ad-tech company dedicated to empowering digital publishers to maximize their ad revenue through innovative technology and strategic partnerships. Our cutting-edge platform optimizes ad layouts, leverages header bidding, and integrates advanced analytics to drive superior results for publishers worldwide. Headquartered in Canada with a strong presence in the LATAM region, we’re looking for a dynamic Commissioned Sales Representative to join our high-performing team and help publishers thrive in the digital advertising ecosystem.

Job Overview

As a Commissioned Sales Representative at MonetizeMore, you will be the face of our brand in the LATAM region, driving new business by identifying, engaging, and converting publisher leads into long-term clients. This role starts as a commission-only position, offering uncapped earning potential for high performers. Upon consistently meeting sales targets, you will transition to a competitive fixed salary plus commission structure, rewarding your success with stability and growth opportunities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead Generation and Prospecting: Identify and target high-potential publishers in the LATAM region through research, networking, and industry events.
  • Client Engagement: Build and maintain strong relationships with publishers, understanding their needs and presenting tailored ad-tech solutions from Monetize More.
  • Sales Conversion: Drive the full sales cycle from initial outreach to closing deals, leveraging product demos, proposals, and negotiations to secure partnerships.
  • Market Representation: Represent MonetizeMore at industry conferences, webinars, and networking events, establishing the company as a trusted leader in ad-tech.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with the account management and technical teams to ensure seamless onboarding and optimization for new clients.
  • Reporting and Analytics: Track sales performance using CRM tools, providing regular updates on pipeline progress and market insights to leadership.
  • Market Intelligence: Stay informed on LATAM ad-tech trends, competitor offerings, and publisher needs to refine sales strategies.

Qualifications

  • Experience: 2+ years of B2B sales experience, preferably in ad-tech, digital advertising, or SaaS industries.
  • Industry Knowledge: Familiarity with digital advertising concepts such as header bidding, programmatic advertising, ad optimization, and publisher monetization.
  • Skills:
    • Proven ability to generate and close leads in a competitive market.
    • Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
    • Proficiency with CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot) and sales analytics.
    • Self-motivated with a strong drive to succeed in a commission-based environment.
  • Regional Expertise: Understanding of the LATAMdigital publishing landscape, with fluency in English and preferably one additional LATAM language (Portuguese, Spanish, French).
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, or a related field (preferred but not mandatory).

Compensation Structure

  • 0–$10,000 Monthly Revenue: 10% commission.
  • $10,001–$25,000 Monthly Revenue: 12% commission.
  • $25,001–$50,000 Monthly Revenue: 15% commission.
  • $50,001+ Monthly Revenue: 18% commission.
Note: Commissions are calculated based on the revenue generated from new client acquisitions and are paid monthly.

Why Join Monetize More?

  • Innovative Environment: Work with a leading ad-tech platform that empowers publishers to succeed.
  • Uncapped Earnings: Maximize your income through a lucrative commission structure designed for high performers.
  • Career Growth: Transition to a salaried role with opportunities to advance into leadership positions.
  • Impactful Work: Help publishers in the LATAM region unlock their full revenue potential with cutting-edge technology.
  • Team Culture: Join a passionate, collaborative team with a global presence and a commitment to excellence.

title: Commissioned Sales Representative - LATAM Region (Remote)
description:
About Monetize More

Monetize More is a leading ad-tech company dedicated to empowering digital publishers to maximize their ad revenue through innovative technology and strategic partnerships. Our cutting-edge platform optimizes ad layouts, leverages header bidding, and integrates advanced analytics to drive superior results for publishers worldwide. Headquartered in Canada with a strong presence in the APAC region, we’re looking for a dynamic Commissioned Sales Representative to join our high-performing team and help publishers thrive in the digital advertising ecosystem.

Job Overview

As a Commissioned Sales Representative at MonetizeMore, you will be the face of our brand in the LATAM region, driving new business by identifying, engaging, and converting publisher leads into long-term clients. This role starts as a commission-only position, offering uncapped earning potential for high performers. Upon consistently meeting sales targets, you will transition to a competitive fixed salary plus commission structure, rewarding your success with stability and growth opportunities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead Generation and Prospecting: Identify and target high-potential publishers in the LATAM region through research, networking, and industry events.
  • Client Engagement: Build and maintain strong relationships with publishers, understanding their needs and presenting tailored ad-tech solutions from Monetize More.
  • Sales Conversion: Drive the full sales cycle from initial outreach to closing deals, leveraging product demos, proposals, and negotiations to secure partnerships.
  • Market Representation: Represent MonetizeMore at industry conferences, webinars, and networking events, establishing the company as a trusted leader in ad-tech.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with the account management and technical teams to ensure seamless onboarding and optimization for new clients.
  • Reporting and Analytics: Track sales performance using CRM tools, providing regular updates on pipeline progress and market insights to leadership.
  • Market Intelligence: Stay informed on LATAM ad-tech trends, competitor offerings, and publisher needs to refine sales strategies.

Qualifications

  • Experience: 2+ years of B2B sales experience, preferably in ad-tech, digital advertising, or SaaS industries.
  • Industry Knowledge: Familiarity with digital advertising concepts such as header bidding, programmatic advertising, ad optimization, and publisher monetization.
  • Skills:
    • Proven ability to generate and close leads in a competitive market.
    • Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
    • Proficiency with CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot) and sales analytics.
    • Self-motivated with a strong drive to succeed in a commission-based environment.
  • Regional Expertise: Understanding of the LATAMdigital publishing landscape, with fluency in English and preferably one additional LATAM language (Portuguese, Spanish, French).
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, or a related field (preferred but not mandatory).

Compensation Structure

  • 0–$10,000 Monthly Revenue: 10% commission.
  • $10,001–$25,000 Monthly Revenue: 12% commission.
  • $25,001–$50,000 Monthly Revenue: 15% commission.
  • $50,001+ Monthly Revenue: 18% commission.
Note: Commissions are calculated based on the revenue generated from new client acquisitions and are paid monthly.

Why Join Monetize More?

  • Innovative Environment: Work with a leading ad-tech platform that empowers publishers to succeed.
  • Uncapped Earnings: Maximize your income through a lucrative commission structure designed for high performers.
  • Career Growth: Transition to a salaried role with opportunities to advance into leadership positions.
  • Impactful Work: Help publishers in the APAC region unlock their full revenue potential with cutting-edge technology.
  • Team Culture: Join a passionate, collaborative team with a global presence and a commitment to excellence.

title: E tech lead
description:
Sobre nós

Somos uma startup recifense focada no desenvolvimento de soluções digitais inovadoras que geram impacto real no setor público. Atuamos em áreas essenciais como saúde, educação e justiça, sempre com o propósito de transformar serviços públicos por meio da tecnologia. Procuramos profissionais que entendam a importância do sucesso dos nossos clientes públicos, tenham compromisso com a geração de valor e saibam atuar em contextos desafiadores e estratégicos. Se você quer fazer parte de uma operação em plena expansão e contribuir com uma equipe estruturada e orientada a resultados, essa oportunidade é para você.

Sobre a oportunidade

Estamos em busca de um Tech Lead para integrar nossa equipe. Seu papel será liderar tecnicamente o desenvolvimento do nosso produto de gerenciamento de atendimento (Service Management), construído sobre nossa plataforma low-code. O desafio é guiar o time na criação de uma solução robusta e escalável, promovendo inovação e excelência técnica.

Responsabilidades

  • Garantir o alinhamento técnico entre times e especialistas, assegurando coesão arquitetural e boas práticas.
  • Avaliar e apoiar decisões técnicas em frontend (Vue.js), backend (Node.js, Express), banco de dados (MySQL) e cloud (GCP), em conjunto com especialistas de cada área.
  • Definir e documentar diretrizes arquiteturais, priorizando escalabilidade, eficiência e segurança.
  • Mentorar o time de desenvolvimento, incentivando boas práticas e a troca de conhecimento entre áreas.
  • Atuar como ponte entre desenvolvimento, produto e design, alinhando soluções técnicas aos objetivos estratégicos.
  • Planejar, delegar e acompanhar atividades, equilibrando prazos e qualidade.

Principais desafios

  • Evoluir nosso UI Builder: Participar da evolução do construtor de componentes e páginas, que permite criar telas e fluxos completos utilizando recursos do Vue.js por meio de interface, com alguns cliques e poucas linhas de código. Nosso objetivo é trazer a experiência de codar para o UI Builder, permitindo que até páginas mais complexas possam ser construídas nele.
  • Desenvolver nossa solução white label: Contribuir para a evolução do motor de criação de plataformas white label, que oferece funcionalidades nativas como autenticação, gerenciamento de usuários, permissões, construtor de formulários, CRUD de tabelas SQL via interface, CSM, entre outras. Tudo isso em um ambiente isolado para cada cliente, com possibilidade de customizações específicas.
  • Aprimorar nosso marketplace de páginas: Criar e expandir o marketplace que permite a publicação, instalação e gestão de páginas desenvolvidas em Vue, compartilháveis entre diferentes clientes do nosso ecossistema.
  • Expandir nossa biblioteca de componentes: Desenvolver componentes únicos e reutilizáveis, como formulários dinâmicos, calendários, gráficos Gantt, listas com integração nativa a APIs etc.
  • Desenvolver soluções de IA e Machine Learning: Criar fluxos com LLMs, integrando funções acionáveis em contextos específicos (como consultas em banco de dados). Implementar RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) por meio de vetorização de dados, buscas por similaridade e integração com LLM.
  • Automatizar com fluxos low-code/no-code: Implementar soluções usando ferramentas como N8N e ActivePieces, construindo fluxos e APIs completas via interface. Também criar novos nós reutilizáveis por toda a equipe de desenvolvimento.
  • Contribuir para o open source: Apoiar a abertura dos nossos produtos para a comunidade, fomentando colaboração global e ampliando o impacto das soluções.

Informações adicionais

  • Contratação PJ.
  • Trabalho remoto, com encontros presenciais ocasionais em Recife (valorizamos esses momentos, mas não são uma exigência).
  • Horários flexíveis, com foco em resultados.

Por que trabalhar na Beyond?

  • Impacto positivo real: Nossos produtos transformam áreas como educação, saúde e direito.
  • Crescimento acelerado: Investimos no seu desenvolvimento por meio de cursos, workshops e eventos.
  • Equipe de alto nível: Ambiente colaborativo, com aprendizado constante.
  • Cultura inclusiva: Valorizamos diversidade, bem-estar e crescimento profissional.

Benefícios e bem-estar

  • Check in premiado: Cada ida ao escritório gera um número da sorte para concorrer a prêmios semanais, mensais e anuais.

About Monetize More

Monetize More is a leading ad-tech company dedicated to empowering digital publishers to maximize their ad revenue through innovative technology and strategic partnerships. Our cutting-edge platform optimizes ad layouts, leverages header bidding, and integrates advanced analytics to drive superior results for publishers worldwide. Job Overview

As a Commissioned Sales Representative at MonetizeMore, you will be the face of our brand in the LATAM region, driving new business by identifying, engaging, and converting publisher leads into long-term clients. This role starts as a commission-only position, offering uncapped earning potential for high performers. Upon consistently meeting sales targets, you will transition to a competitive fixed salary plus commission structure, rewarding your success with stability and growth opportunities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead Generation and Prospecting: Identify and target high-potential publishers in the LATAM region through research, networking, and industry events.
  • Client Engagement: Build and maintain strong relationships with publishers, understanding their needs and presenting tailored ad-tech solutions from Monetize More.
  • Sales Conversion: Drive the full sales cycle from initial outreach to closing deals, leveraging product demos, proposals, and negotiations to secure partnerships.
  • Market Representation: Represent MonetizeMore at industry conferences, webinars, and networking events, establishing the company as a trusted leader in ad-tech.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with the account management and technical teams to ensure seamless onboarding and optimization for new clients.
  • Reporting and Analytics: Track sales performance using CRM tools, providing regular updates on pipeline progress and market insights to leadership.
  • Market Intelligence: Stay informed on LATAM ad-tech trends, competitor offerings, and publisher needs to refine sales strategies.

Qualifications

  • Experience: 2+ years of B2B sales experience, preferably in ad-tech, digital advertising, or SaaS industries.
  • Industry Knowledge: Familiarity with digital advertising concepts such as header bidding, programmatic advertising, ad optimization, and publisher monetization.
  • Skills:
    • Proven ability to generate and close leads in a competitive market.
    • Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
    • Proficiency with CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot) and sales analytics.
    • Self-motivated with a strong drive to succeed in a commission-based environment.
  • Regional Expertise: Understanding of the LATAMdigital publishing landscape, with fluency in English and preferably one additional LATAM language (Portuguese, Spanish, French).
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, or a related field (preferred but not mandatory).

Compensation Structure

  • 0–$10,000 Monthly Revenue: 10% commission.
  • $10,001–$25,000 Monthly Revenue: 12% commission.
  • $25,001–$50,000 Monthly Revenue: 15% commission.
  • $50,001+ Monthly Revenue: 18% commission.
Note: Commissions are calculated based on the revenue generated from new client acquisitions and are paid monthly.

Why Join Monetize More?

  • Innovative Environment: Work with a leading ad-tech platform that empowers publishers to succeed.
  • Uncapped Earnings: Maximize your income through a lucrative commission structure designed for high performers.
  • Career Growth: Transition to a salaried role with opportunities to advance into leadership positions.
  • Impactful Work: Help publishers in the APAC region unlock their full revenue potential with cutting-edge technology.
  • Team Culture: Join a passionate, collaborative team with a global presence and a commitment to excellence.

Overview

Backend Software Engineer (Node, Python, Ruby on Rails or Go!)

About the Role: As a Software Engineer at BWZ you are responsible for the whole development process, starting with discovering, planning and developing, ending with testing and deploying. You will work in an environment that offers freedom with responsibility, and encourages simplicity with risk taking.

You will be working in BWZ's Tech Team, highly involved in the development of our back-end systems and integrations (using Node.js, Python, AWS, etc), but also participating in the development and architecture of our multi-site Web Platform (built in WordPress), our Ad Tech Platform (built in Ruby on Rails), among many other systems and products. You can work remotely or in a flexible regime, if you are in Curitiba, Brazil. Keep in mind that our teams work in the PST time zone, and your hours should be at least partially compatible with it.

Responsibilities

  • Develop internal systems used by dozens of employees, as well as customer facing systems used by thousands of clients.
  • Collaborate with the Technology Director and BWZ Labs Team to support the Web Platform.
  • Research and learn new technologies and solutions, proposing implementations to fit product needs to improve performance and scale.

Who You Are

  • You are a software engineer with meaningful experience building web applications.
  • You are good at prioritizing your own work.
  • You are curious about how things are done and how they work.
  • You communicate deliveries and demands effectively with teammates and stakeholders.
  • You automate repetitive tasks and enjoy testing new things.

How Your Success Will Be Measured

  • Focus on effectiveness rather than effort; accountability for results, not hours worked.
  • Part of a collaborative team where teamwork is a key factor.

Your Skill Set Includes

  • Curiosity to understand how things work and openness to learning new technologies.
  • Great time-management and prioritization skills.
  • Openness to learn and use new programming languages.
  • Ability to read/write documentation for others and good English communication.

Required Experience

  • Meaningful experience building web applications using languages like PHP, Python, Ruby, GoLang, or similar.
  • Track record of contributing to end-to-end system development (UI, server-side logic, infrastructure).
  • Experience with system design of web applications.
  • Experience with JavaScript technologies such as React, Node.js, Next.js, or similar.
  • Solid understanding of databases and cloud infrastructure.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience with AWS-based architecture.
  • Experience with Cloudflare platform.
  • Experience working with CMS (WordPress or similar).
  • Experience using AI IDEs and building LLM-based applications/workflows.
  • Experience with MVC frameworks and API development.
  • Experience writing tests and building deployment pipelines.

About Us

Black and White Zebra is a rapidly growing, independent media tech company headquartered in Vancouver, B.C. Canada. Since 2012, our portfolio of influential digital publications has been helping millions of people succeed at work. Our brands cover project management, product management, people management, customer experience, quality assurance and others, with the goal of connecting people with the knowledge, skills and tools they need to succeed professionally. We started in 2011 as The Digital Project Manager blog, founded by CEO Ben Aston. We’ve grown into an international team of 70+ creators, strategists, and innovators with a portfolio of more than 14 online publications. We have a startup-like, impact-driven environment with the creativity of an agency and the diversity of a global company. We’ve ranked in The Globe and Mail’s Fastest Growing Company list and received a CMI award for Best Digital Publication. We are listed as a Top Employer in Canada and BC. Our mission is to create a playbook for the future of work and empower communities to shape it. Diversity, Equity and Inclusion: Black and White Zebra is an equal opportunity employer and considers all candidates for employment regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, citizenship, age, disability, marital status, military or veteran status, sexual orientation, or any other protected category. We celebrate all backgrounds and attributes that contribute to an impactful and adaptable team.

title: Senior Product Data Analyst
description:
This range is provided by LawnStarter. Your actual pay will be based on your skills and experience — talk with your recruiter to learn more.

Base pay range

$60,000.00/yr - $70,000.00/yr

As a Sr. Product Data Analyst, you'll be directly impacting our results through insights and reports. You'll be working close to product managers, researchers, and other business stakeholders, helping with prioritization, assessments, and business recommendations. It will be your responsibility, alongside the Analytics team, to nurture the data-driven culture within the company, making data easier to consume, be it through interactive reports, easy-to-use datasets, documentation, training.

Help Us Build the Future of Outdoor Services

At LawnStarter, we are transforming the $100B+ outdoor home services industry—making it easier for homeowners to book, manage, and enjoy services like lawn care, landscaping, and more. With $30M+ in venture funding and solid traction, we are investing in the next generation of our platform—and we are looking for a Senior Product Data Analyst to help drive it.

See what we are building!

Problems to be solved

Your primary responsibility will be to empower our organization to be more data-driven, with multiple avenues to accomplish that, such as:

  • Modeling & Analysis: A marketplace is a complex system with various moving parts and often conflicting signals. This creates opportunities to identify gaps, insights, or optimizations. The analyses and models may range from simple AB tests to multivariate models on retention or ETA. You should have advanced experience in SQL and intermediate experience in Python or R.
  • Reporting: A complex system creates many metrics to track for running the business efficiently. You will work with teams to understand their needs and help the Analytics team create and maintain a reliable, user-friendly reporting system, primarily using Tableau and Metabase.
  • Analytics Engineering: Occasionally you will work on the inner layers of our Data Warehouse to provide clean and documented datasets for reports and end users. Understanding business needs and translating them into our DW is crucial; we use DBT for data transformation, so SQL experience is a must.

Requirements

  • Experience: 4+ years in data & analytics at data-driven companies
  • Education: STEM or business background or relevant education that enables you to empower the organization to be more data-driven
  • Learning Mindset: You take pride in understanding problems deeply, asking the right questions, and approaching problems with structure and logic. You adapt to the business as needed rather than applying a fixed process blindly.
  • Team player: You collaborate effectively with others and create an environment where people are excited to work with you, with intellectual honesty and trust
  • Business focus: You understand how your analysis connects with product, customers, and financials, and can drill down metrics from top to bottom as needed
  • Bias for action: You balance careful analysis with getting things done, avoiding unnecessary perfectionism or rigid full-solution builds before validating with real use

VERY IMPORTANT REMINDER: Please upload your English resume—applications without it will not be considered.

Benefits

  • Salary range: $60-$70k USD annually
  • Work from anywhere
  • Flexible hours—complete work on your schedule
  • Unlimited PTO — Focus on results. Take time you need to recharge or work hard when you return

LawnStarter is building the future of outdoor home services. Want to help us shape it?
Apply now and let's grow together.

Overview

O isaac é a maior plataforma de soluções financeiras feita para escolas. Impulsionamos as instituições oferecendo receita garantida e proporcionando mais flexibilidade de pagamento para as famílias.

Nosso objetivo é facilitar a gestão financeira, acabando com a dor de cabeça e permitindo que a escola consiga focar na missão de educar , dedicando mais tempo e recursos para tirar os planos do papel.

Nos últimos 4 anos, já ajudamos mais de 2.000 escolas , garantimos mais de R$5bi em mensalidades garantidas, e ajudamos a aumentar em 9% o número de matrículas em nossas escolas parceiras.

A cultura do isaac incentiva a autonomia, a mão na massa, o trabalho em equipe e o uso de dados para construir soluções inovadoras.

Temos muito para construir e transformar na Educação brasileira, e você pode fazer parte dessa revolução, vivenciando o impacto do seu trabalho na sociedade!

Vem com a gente?

Que tal fazer parte de um time brilhante em uma startup com DNA de Fintech + Edtech que está transformando o futuro da educação no Brasil?

noisaac, vivemos desafios grandiosos e instigantes, construindo um produto totalmente do zero. Nosso ponto de partida é sempre a investigação profunda dos reais problemas de escolas e responsáveis, para então idealizar e colocar em prática soluções simples, escaláveis e de alto impacto.

Mais do que conhecimento técnico, valorizamos colaboração, abertura ao aprendizado e adaptabilidade para navegar na jornada de crescimento acelerado de um produto em constante evolução.

No dia a dia você irá:

  • Traduzir os objetivos estratégicos da empresa em metas claras e acionáveis para o time;
  • Monitorar tendências e oportunidades de melhoria contínua, garantindo que o time atue de forma alinhada às necessidades do negócio;
  • Liderar projetos complexos, acompanhando métricas de sucesso e removendo impedimentos para o time;
  • Revisar e otimizar fluxos de trabalho para aumentar a produtividade da equipe;
  • Garantir alinhamento contínuo com Product Managers (PMs), Designers e outras áreas de interface;
  • Planejar e gerenciar a alocação de recursos do time, equilibrando carga de trabalho e competências individuais.

Para participar do nosso processo você precisa ter:

  • Experiência prévia em liderança técnica de equipes de engenharia de software.
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis e boas práticas de desenvolvimento de software.
  • Conhecimento em estratégias de escalabilidade e impacto a longo prazo.
  • Auxílio alimentação e/ou refeição (Flash flexível - R$40,50/dia);
  • Auxílio home office no primeiro mês de trabalho (R$200,00);
  • Plano de saúde e odontológico Sulamérica sem mensalidade e com coparticipação;
  • Licença maternidade (180 dias) e paternidade (30 dias) estendida;

  • Incentivo à educação - parcerias com diversas instituições de ensino;
  • ArcoLab - plataforma de educação corporativa;
  • Desconto em passagens aéreas e hospedagens;
  • Reembolso para evolução profissional (cursos, palestras, eventos, etc);
  • Férias flexíveis (antecipação de 15 dias de férias após 6 meses).

We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!

Job Description

The primary responsibility of the Senior Engineer - Systems Technical Support position is to remotely provide support for server and storage equipment located at customer sites. You will work in the server environment. We ask that you have self-initiative, ownership, a desire to follow issues to resolution, commercial sensitivity, responsiveness, collaboration, and technical expertise.

You will report to the Supervisor Managed Services

Main location: Bogota, Colombia. We can consider other cities.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  • You will focus on remote managed services for data centers located in manufacturing facilities. Have technical expertise for computer environments and will be instrumental in bridging the industrial and information technology paradigms.
  • You will support modifying and maintaining Windows Server Operating Systems, Active Directory and Directory Services, and performance monitoring techniques on server software and hardware.
  • You will support many VMware products such as vCenter, ESXi versions 6.x+, HorizonView, vSAN and must have experience managing these environments in a production environment.
  • Provide troubleshooting assistance remotely by telephone and email on products to Rockwell Automation field service personnel, distributors, integrators, and customers. Work with other engineers, manage and deal with high pressure situations.
  • Investigate and verify reported product problems in software, firmware, hardware and documentation. Document the problem, work with appropriate group to resolve the problem, and follow up with the Rockwell Automation representative or customer when the problem is solved.
  • Provides documentation of all actions taken in the appropriate systems, set expectations with customers and follow-up on an action item or activity needed to resolve a problem being experienced by a customer. You will update and author Technical Notes and other documentation to inform Rockwell Automation personnel, domestic or international, of solutions to commonly experienced problems, work around, installation practices that create problems to improve customer satisfaction and acceptance.

BASIC REQUIREMENTS:

  • Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, information technology, computer programming, or similar.

PREFERRED REQUIREMENTS:

  • VMWare Certified Professional (VCP).
  • 3 years' experience as a VMware engineer.
  • Proficiency in VMware associated programs and coding languages, such as Windows Server, MS IIS, SAN/vSAN architectures.
  • Knowledge of the fundamentals of VMware solutions and related technologies.
  • Programming Language for cloud platforms: Python, Java, JavaScript, Power Shell
  • Exceptional analytical and technical skills.
  • Availability to resolve urgent VMware environment problems outside of business hours.
  • Familiarity with network and SAN switching technologies.
  • Good English reading, writing and verbal communication skills
  • Strict adherence to company standards and procedures.
  • Excellent trouble shooting skills
What We Offer:

  • Comprehensive mindfulness programs with a premium membership to Calm
  • Volunteer Paid Time off available after 6 months of employment for eligible employees.
  • Company volunteer and donation matching program – Your volunteer hours or personal cash donations to an eligible charity can be matched with a charitable donation.
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Personalized wellbeing programs through our OnTrack program
  • On-demand digital course library for professional development... and other local benefits!

ALP SUPPLY CO is a fast-growing, profitable consumer packaged goods (CPG) company in the nicotine pouch sector. Lean, efficient, and built on a foundation of innovation, we are now expanding through our first wave of strategic hiring since launch. This is a rare opportunity to join a high-growth organization at a pivotal stage, with strong potential for upward mobility and long-term career advancement.
Position Overview
We are seeking a results-driven and relationship-oriented Brand Partnerships Director to oversee all
partnership opportunities for ALP. This role will vet and respond to inbound partnership inquiries,
develop and execute proactive outreach strategies, and manage ALP’s ambassador, affiliate, and
loyalty programs.
The ideal candidate has a strong understanding of brand alignment, the ability to evaluate ROI and
strategic fit, and a proven track record in forming successful partnerships that boost brand growth
and awareness.
Reports To: Sr. Director of Marketing/VP of Marketing.

Key Responsibilities

1. Inbound Partnership Vetting & Management
• Serve as the primary point of contact for all inbound partnership, sponsorship, and collaboration requests.
• Evaluate each opportunity for brand fit, audience alignment, potential ROI, capital requirements, human resource allocation, timing, and initial deal structure.
• Prepare recommendations for leadership approval, including cost-benefit analysis and expected deliverables.
• Manage ongoing communication with potential partners, from initial inquiry through contract execution and partnership launch.
2. Strategic Partnership Development & Outreach
• Build a pipeline of targeted partnership opportunities across relevant industries, brands, and influencers that align with ALP’s mission and target audience.
• Develop and execute an outreach strategy to secure high-value collaborations.
• Negotiate partnership terms, ensuring mutually beneficial outcomes.
• Maintain a database of partnership prospects, including contact information, meeting notes, and opportunity status.
• Manage all partnerships from beginning to end, ensuring successful collaborations and reporting on partnership KPIs, results, and consumer insights.
3. Program Oversight – Ambassadors, Affiliates, and Loyalty
• Manage the day-to-day operations of ALP’s brand ambassador, affiliate, and loyalty programs.
• Recruit, onboard, and nurture relationships with ambassadors and affiliates to ensure active engagement and program growth.
• Develop incentive structures, content toolkits, and campaign calendars to maximize program participation.
• Monitor program performance, track KPIs, and provide reports with actionable recommendations for growth.
• Ensure all participants remain compliant with brand guidelines and legal requirements.
• Oversee deliverables from partners and program participants, ensuring timely execution and brand compliance.
4. Cross-Functional Collaboration
• Work closely with the marketing team to maximize the visibility and impact of partnerships and programs.
• Coordinate with product and sales teams to align partnership activations with product launches, retail promotions, and campaign calendars.
5. Industry Awareness & Networking
• Stay up to date on competitor partnerships, cultural trends, and relevant industry events.
• Represent ALP at key events, trade shows, and networking opportunities to foster new relationships.

Se você gosta de trabalhar com o público, tem boa comunicação, é organizado (a), tem o sentimento de dono e responsabilidade essa vaga é para você.

O Promotor de Merchandising é na linha de frente com os nossos clientes representando a Coty e fazendo com que os nossos produtos estejam sempre disponíveis para os nossos consumidores.

Responsabilidades

  • Reposição de mercadoria
  • Organização do layout
  • Conquista e montagem de pontos extras
  • Manuseio de ferramentas de controle via celular
  • Facilidade com aplicativos via celular
  • Habilidade com trabalho em equipe e negociação

  • Vaga para todos os estados do Brasil

Benefícios

  • Plano de Saúde
  • Vale Alimentação e Refeição
  • 40% de desconto nos produtos Coty

Sobre a Coty

Fundada em Paris em 1904, a Coty é uma das maiores empresas de beleza do mundo. Com portfólio de marcas consagradas em fragrâncias, maquiagens e esmaltes, cuidados com pele e corpo, a empresa atende clientes em todo o mundo e está presente em cerca de 130 países. A Coty e as suas marcas estimulam o empoderamento das pessoas para que se expressem livresmente, criando suas próprias visões de beleza; além de serem comprometidas em fomentar positivo impacto no planeta.

No Brasil, o Grupo Coty conta com aproximadamente 2,4 mil funcionários alocados em suas empresas, localizadas no Estado de São Paulo (área de Pesquisa e Desenvolvimento e sede administrativa); no Estado de Goiás (fábrica Savoy e o principal centro de distribuição); e no Estado do Rio de Janeiro (centro de distribuição).

Localmente, fabricamos e comercializamos milhões de produtos todos os anos, de nossas tradicionais marcas brasileiras - como Risqué, Monange, Bozzano, Paixão, Cenoura & Bronze e outras muito conhecidas pelos brasileiros. Além disso, também comercializamos nossas fragrâncias internacionais, licenciadas de famosas marcas (Calvin Klein, Lacoste, Hugo Boss, Chloé, Burberry, Gucci, Tiffany, entre outras); e produtos de maquiagem e skincare, com Kylie Cosmetics e Kylie Skin.

Na Coty, acreditamos que hoje ninguém pode controlar ou deve ditar o que é ou não bonito. Estamos em busca de uma nova era de beleza - uma em que, juntos, a cocriamos de maneira que você possa se expressar da forma que desejar. Como companhia dessa indústria, nosso propósito é viabilizar, conjuntamente, todas as visões de beleza.

O conceito de beleza não é fixo; é algo fluido, como a água – em constante evolução e adaptação. Não é singular, e sim plural. É hora de desconstruir todos os conceitos de beleza.

Tornamos ‘fearless kindness’ ( sem medo de ser gentil, gentileza destemida ) a base dos nossos valores, porque sabemos que agora, mais do que nunca, o mundo precisa de gentileza. É um atributo e uma ação que tem um efeito de ondulação que irradia muito - gentileza para consigo mesmo, gentileza para com os outros e gentileza para com o planeta.

Portanto, hoje e todos os dias, junte-se a nós para fazer da ‘fearless kindness’ a base para suas decisões e ações; juntos, vamos causar impacto positivo no nosso próprio bem-estar mental e daqueles que nos rodeiam.

Queremos PROFISSIONAIS DIVERSOS no nosso time!

Acreditamos que vivências diferentes tornam o time vencedor. Por isso, nossas oportunidades são para todos, independentemente de raça, religião, cor, nacionalidade, idade, gênero, deficiência, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, expressão de gênero, estado civil ou qualquer outra característica. Ou seja, valorizamos exatamente quem VOCÊ é!

About This Opportunity

As a Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET), you’ll support teams across both Waterfall and Agile teams by delivering robust automated testing solutions. Overview

O SC (Sort Center) está em busca de profissionais engajados e apaixonados por inovação para ajudar a desenvolver um processo logístico de classe mundial, garantindo entregas dentro do prazo e com a máxima eficiência de custo. Essa posição requer um profissional proativo e com espírito de liderança. Você representará uma posição estratégica nas operações de transporte da Amazon, enquanto trabalhamos constantemente para melhorar os níveis de serviço, a eficiência das capacidades e a otimização dos custos do Sort Center Brasil. Isso garantirá que as promessas feitas aos nossos valiosos clientes sejam cumpridas de forma consistente.

Uma pessoa especialista em operações de transporte facilita o fluxo de informações entre diferentes partes interessadas (transportadoras/hubs/armazéns) e resolve quaisquer possíveis problemas que afetem a experiência do cliente e a continuidade dos negócios. Além disso, trabalhará em operações externas com relacionamento FCs / ATS Middle Mile / TOM e AMZL, garantindo que nossas capacidades sejam sempre atingidas com excelência e ainda garantindo a visibilidade dessas capacidades para as áreas parceiras e para a gerência sênior da operação.

Como especialista em transporte, você deve ser capaz de resolver problemas com agilidade, utilizando ferramentas internas e tomando decisões assertivas em tempo real. É essencial compreender os requisitos, analisar dados, identificar tendências e impulsionar a experiência do cliente sem impactar os prazos estabelecidos. Conhecimentos básicos em logística e habilidades de comunicação claras, tanto na forma escrita quanto oral, são indispensáveis. Além disso, o profissional deve propor melhorias nos processos e ter a determinação de implementá-las até a conclusão.

Essa posição estará envolvida na expansão do Sort Center no Brasil, trabalhando em turnos de 3x2. Modelo de trabalho: Presencial, em turnos pela escala 3x2. É necessário ter disponibilidade para trabalhar em horários/turnos/áreas flexíveis, incluindo fins de semana, noites e/ou feriados.

Key job responsibilities

  • Estabelecer comunicação eficiente com clientes externos (ATS Middle Mile, TOM, Time de Operações do Sort Center e AMZL) e clientes internos (centros de atendimento ROC, estações de entrega);
  • Possuir capacidade de extrair dados de vários bancos de dados (usando Excel, Access, SQL e/ou outros sistemas de gerenciamento de dados) e realizar relatórios e análises ad hoc conforme necessário é um diferencial desejável;
  • Desenvolver e/ou compreender métricas de desempenho relevantes para impulsionar os resultados do negócio;
  • Entender rapidamente o impacto das tendências nos resultados comerciais e tomar decisões com base nos dados disponíveis;
  • Encaminhar de forma estruturada problemas ou variações nas informações e dados para os proprietários e equipes relevantes, garantindo a execução de soluções;
  • Trabalhar dentro de várias restrições de tempo para atender às necessidades críticas dos negócios, mensurando e identificando as atividades realizadas;
  • Responder pelo gerenciamento de capacidade de linha e gerenciamento de volume, incluindo a realização de uploads de limites de capacidade no sistema;
  • Garantir visibilidade às atividades de Capacidades, fornecendo suporte direto ao time de operações.

A day in the life

O Sort Center é o Middle Mile (MM), uma parte da estrutura da Amazon Transportation Service (ATS), onde os pacotes são enviados para serem consolidados de diferentes origens e serem classificados e enviados ao destino para melhorar a velocidade de entrega, a ocupação do veículo e a frequência da rota. A estratégia do Sort Center para o Brasil tem como objetivo desenvolver nossa rede de transporte apoiando a expansão dos programas da AMZL, Amazon Air e Market Place.

Qualifications

Necessary Skills and Knowledge

  • Memorandum, Acquisition Plans, Sole Source Justifications, and other documents common to the acquisition process
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited educational institution and a minimum of five (5) to eight (8) years of experience in contracting providing service to Federal clients. Or at least 24 semester hours in any combination of the following fields: accounting, business, finance, law, contracts, purchasing, economics or management.
  • MUST have previous Bureau of Prisons (BOP) experience.
  • Minimum five (5) years of experience in contracting providing service to Federal clients.
  • Experienced, skilled, and knowledgeable in all aspects of Federal Government acquisition (i.e. requirements development, budgeting and acquisition planning, market research, development of independent cost estimates.)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's degree in a related field.
  • Experience in contract writing system Unified Financial Management (UFMS) preferred.
  • Active Secret clearance preferred.
  • 2 to 4 years of experience supporting Federal Customers (Department of Justice, DOJ highly preferred).

Pay and Benefits

The salary range for this position is $90,000 to $130,000 per year.

At Goldbelt, we value and reward our team's dedication and hard work. We provide a competitive base salary commensurate with your qualifications and experience. As an employee, you\'ll enjoy a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) plan with company matching, tax-deferred savings options, supplementary benefits, paid time off, and professional development opportunities.

description:
Overview

Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world's biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine. By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we're helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms. Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany.

Job Title: Generative AI Associate Analyst (LLM Training – Medical Domain)

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Flexible Contract Role (Part-time, up to 25 hours weekly)

Overview

We are seeking highly qualified professionals with (Master's or PhD) in Medical Microbiology to support the development of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs). As a Rater / AI Trainer, you will play a critical role in shaping how AI understands and communicates complex biomedical knowledge, with a specific focus on microbiological sciences. This role involves evaluating AI-generated responses for scientific accuracy, contextual integrity, and clinical relevance within the field of medical microbiology. Your feedback and annotations will inform the improvement of AI systems used in healthcare education, diagnostics support, public health communication, and biomedical research.

Key Responsibilities

  • Critically assess AI-generated responses in topics including microbial taxonomy, infectious disease mechanisms, host–pathogen interactions, diagnostic microbiology, antimicrobial resistance, and laboratory methodologies.
  • Apply structured annotation to texts, including labeling for scientific correctness, terminology accuracy, logical structure, and clinical relevance.
  • Categorize model outputs using domain-specific taxonomies (e.g., pathogen type, disease process, diagnostic method).
  • Create real-world clinical or laboratory scenarios with researchers to design and test prompts to assess the model's reasoning and adaptability to professional contexts (e.g., interpreting culture reports, recommending diagnostic tests, understanding resistance profiles).

Required Qualifications

  • Master's or PhD in Medical Microbiology, Immunology, or a closely related biomedical discipline.
  • Demonstrated expertise in core areas such as microbial pathogenesis, clinical diagnostics, virology, bacteriology, parasitology, and immunology.
  • Familiarity with laboratory procedures, microbiological instrumentation, and interpretation of diagnostic test results (e.g., blood cultures, PCR, AST).
  • Excellent written communication skills and fluency in English.
  • As part of the project, you are required to complete the English language assessment. The assessment is mandatory & non-billable.

Job description

A Leega é uma empresa focada no atendimento eficiente e inovador em seus clientes.

Main responsibilities

  • Gerenciamento de Dados: responsável por gerenciar e organizar as regras e padrões de conexões de fontes dados a serem utilizados dentro da ferramenta.
  • Desenvolvimento e manutenção de aplicações ETL;
  • Garantir a disponibilidade dos dados para análises e tomada de decisão;
  • Realizar análises para integração de dados estratégicos de diversas fontes.
  • Desenvolver e manter dashboards interativos e relatórios analíticos utilizando Power BI e Looker, com foco na geração de insights acionáveis para diferentes áreas de negócio.
  • Traduzir requisitos de negócio em soluções visuais eficientes, escaláveis e de fácil interpretação para públicos técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com times de dados, engenharia, produto e negócio para garantir a integridade, qualidade e consistência dos dados apresentados.
  • Participar da modelagem de dados para suportar as visualizações, garantindo performance e aderência às boas práticas (ex: uso de views otimizadas, agregações e filtros dinâmicos).
  • Automatizar processos de atualização de dashboards e relatórios, promovendo eficiência e governança.
  • Documentar as soluções desenvolvidas, mantendo repositórios organizados e atualizados.
  • Contribuir com a evolução dos frameworks internos de visualização e com a padronização de boas práticas dentro da equipe.

Experiências Desejadas:

  • Conhecimento avançado na ferramenta Power BI, incluindo todas as suas funcionalidades e capacidades.
  • Experiência prática no desenvolvimento de dashboards em Power BI (DAX, Power Query, uso de gateways, otimização de performance).
  • Experiência na importação, limpeza e organização de dados de várias fontes.
  • Conhecimento de princípios e práticas de gerenciamento de dados.
  • Conhecimento de segurança de dados e experiência na configuração de permissões de usuário.
  • Habilidades de resolução de problemas e a capacidade de solucionar problemas técnicos.
  • Conhecimento de SQL, Python (pandas, matplotlib/seaborn), Git
  • Experiência com o Looker Platform (modelagem com LookML, criação de Explores, Dashboards e visualizações customizadas).
  • Vivência em projetos de dados de médio a grande porte, com interação entre diferentes fontes de dados (ex: bancos relacionais, BigQuery, APIs).
  • Conhecimento em modelagem de dados (conceitual, lógica e física), especialmente para fins analíticos.
  • Conhecimento em conceitos de ETL/ELT, pipelines de dados e integração com ferramentas de visualização.
  • Noções de UX para dataviz, boas práticas de design para dashboards e storytelling com dados.

Requirements and skills

Conhecimentos obrigatórios:

  • Sólidos conhecimentos em Power BI
  • Experiência em Modelagem
  • Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery, Storage, Composer, Pub/Sub, Dataproc, Functions);
  • SQL;
  • Banco de dados relacionais.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com ferramentas ETL "low-code".
  • Trabalho 100% remoto
